items.stem: A report you wrote used an AI draft. The honest step is to:

options.A: Say which parts the AI helped with

items.stem: Why disclose AI use at work?

options.B: People can judge the work fairly and check it

options.C: Drafted with AI help; I reviewed the final text

options.B: When the output affects decisions or other people

items.stem: A simple way to be transparent is to:

options.A: Add one line naming the AI's role

items.stem: Hiding AI use can hurt trust because:

options.C: People may rely on work they think you checked yourself

items.stem: Who is responsible for the final AI-assisted text you send?

options.B: You, the person who sends it

items.stem: Which is a misuse of disclosure?

options.A: Pretending no AI was used at all
options.C: Reviewing the AI draft before sending
